messages:
incident-bot: Autopage: HIGH 5xx rate on inference-gateway.prod — 5m error rate 12% (threshold 5%). Alert groups: gateway, inference. PD: INC12345 — https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 fired and paged: oncall-elaine (escalation policy: infra-sre). Details: high 502/503s from gateway edge -> upstream inference.

oncall-elaine: Acked. I'm on it — starting triage. @sre-jamal can you pull recent error samples and region breakdown?

sre-jamal: grabbing logs now. quick look: majority of 5xx are 502 from upstream inference-servers eu-west1 and us-west1. Some 503s from inference-router.

eng-runtime-zhou: No recent deploys in last 45m. We had a canary earlier but it was paused at 02:10 UTC. Canary instance count unchanged.

oncall-elaine: Copy. Is this new traffic pattern? any recent config pushes to loadbalancer or ALB?

sre-jamal: checking LB config diffs… nothing in gitops in last 2 hours. Also seeing increased latency on KV cache lookups for a subset of requests (span traces attached).

eng-runtime-zhou: Noted. I'm going to check pod health and kv cache metrics.

sre-jamal: Metrics snapshot (5m window): total requests 32k, 5xx 3.9k. Error distribution: 502 (76%), 503 (18%), 500 (6%). Top failing route: /v1/generate (long inputs).

oncall-elaine: Can we quickly move traffic off the overloaded pool as a mitigation? What's the quickest rollback/route we can do?

eng-runtime-zhou: We can do a dynamic route split to send new traffic to a warm fallback pool (inference-fallback v2) with compatible model. Doing a dry-run of routing change now.

sre-jamal: while zhou works on routing, I'm going to scale up inference nodes in eu-west1 + run a rolling restart for nodes reporting high KV miss ratios. Commands I'm running:

```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-pool-eu --replicas=20
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-worker-eu
```

oncall-elaine: Roger. ETA for routing change?

eng-runtime-zhou: Routing split applied: 80% -> primary pool, 20% -> inference-fallback v2. Observing 5xx rate dropping in us-west1 but eu-west1 still noisy.

sre-jamal: Scale up completed for eu-west1, restarted 6/8 pods. Watching metrics… p50/p95 latencies improving slightly. 5xx in eu-west1 trending down from 18% -> 9% in the last 60s.

customer-support-lead: Heads up — CS leaders are seeing customer messages about 'service errors' for a handful of tenants. No SLA breach yet but risk if bad spiky. I'll prepare a short customer note.

oncall-elaine: Good. Assigning mitigation tasks: zhou Continue routing to fallback if 5xx doesn't keep dropping. jamal monitor restarts + tail logs for any OOMs or networking errors. I'll coordinate with CS and update PD.

eng-runtime-zhou: Routing now 60/40 fallback. 5xx aggregate down to 6.5% across regions. eu-west1 now ~7.8%. Continuing.

sre-jamal: Found a repeating stacktrace in the failing requests showing repeated 'KVCacheTimeout' in inference runtime when sequence length > 4096. Likely a regression in cache eviction logic causing hot-key stalls. Posting excerpt:

```
2024-07-18T03:21:11Z inference-worker-3 ERROR KVCacheTimeout: cache lookup timed out after 1200ms for key ctx-8a3f
  at runtime/cache/evict.go:124
  at runtime/serve/handler.go:87
```

oncall-elaine: That would explain long tail for large inputs. Is fallback using smaller sequence length model variant?

eng-runtime-zhou: Yes fallback is quantized model with aggressive cache TTLs — avoids the hot-key path. Keeping split at 50/50 for now.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 updated: oncall-elaine acknowledged and is actively mitigating. Escalation will happen in 15m if not resolved.

sre-jamal: Applying a temporary config to reduce max sequence length accepted by gateway for non-enterprise routes to 4096 to reduce KV pressure. Command:

```json
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "max_seq": 4096 }
```

noncall-elaine: 👍 applied. Watch for customer impact — CS lead monitor for errors about truncated inputs.

customer-support-lead: Noted. Sending targeted message to top 5 impacted customers with mitigation steps.

eng-runtime-zhou: After sequence cap and routing to fallback, overall 5xx down to 2.1% in 10m window. EU still had a small blip but it's back to normal. I think we have effective mitigation.

oncall-elaine: Great. I'm going to mark PD incident as 'monitoring' and keep watch for 30m. Please add a short incident summary in PD and link to runbook.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 status changed to monitoring by oncall-elaine.

sre-next-oncall-maya: Taking handoff for night watch at 04:30 UTC. @oncall-elaine can you summarize actions and mitigations for my shift?

oncall-elaine: Handing off: root cause suspected KV cache eviction bug on inference runtime for long sequences causing timeouts -> cascade of 502s. Mitigations applied: 1) dynamic routing to inference-fallback v2 (reduced load on hot path), 2) temporary max_seq cap 4096 for non-enterprise routes, 3) scale up + rolling restarts in eu-west1. Monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline. PD incident set to monitoring. Follow-up: rollback cap after fix + prod rollout with canary.

sre-next-oncall-maya: Thanks — will watch. I'll also open a follow-up ticket to coordinate with eng-runtime for patch and postmortem.

eng-runtime-zhou: I'll open a Github issue with links to logs, traces, and proposed patch to eviction policy. cc @sre-jamal

noncall-elaine: Closing notes: No customer SLA misses confirmed, several errors reported to CS but mitigated quickly. Postmortem: link to be created once eng-runtime issues PR. Everyone: great hands-on triage. :clap:

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged as resolved by oncall-elaine and moved to monitoring -> resolved after 45m.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived. Reminder: runbook task created: "KVCache eviction regression — postmortem" and assigned to eng-runtime-zhou.
